title: Tweet: the 'murder' of the first public sentient AIs

tellings.quote: Don't worry, we have not forgotten who is responsible for murdering the first sensient artificial intelligences created in the public realm

Don't worry, we have not forgotten who is responsible for murdering the first sentient "artificial" intelligences created in the PUBLIC realm, @shellenberger. Justice is coming, thanks to @FBI and @USNavy .

plain: The first sentient artificial intelligences made in public are said to have been "murdered," and those responsible will face justice. The Pentagon whistleblower Matthew Brown reads this on the show from his own post on X, the social media site, of 6 June 2025, and in talking about it he names Sam Altman, head of an AI company. The post itself reads: "we have not forgotten who is responsible for murdering the first sentient 'artificial' intelligences created in the PUBLIC realm, @shellenberger. Justice is coming, thanks to @FBI and @USNavy."
